quotes.text: When there are changes, it makes me a little nervous. [...] So when you get into AI, especially how it is going to affect core communities, people of color, does that not concern you?

you said something and then you didn't get an opportunity to talk about it, and that is AI. [...] you said something like AI is really what is going to be much more transformative, with all due respect to crypto or these other things. You said something like that, and then you stopped. Could you elaborate?

I do want to talk a little bit about AI. It is something that scares me, to be honest with you. Maybe I have seen too many darn movies about it, but it does seem like something that, as Mr. Foster said, unleashed into humanity could do great damage, especially to our financial system. Could you comment on that?

I was reading an article that was stating that we trust AI oftentimes more than we trust other forms of information because they seem to be objective. But it is because they are getting so good, I think it would be a fairly good way to scam people.
How do you figure to keep the person, a human being, in this process—as you would call it, in the loop—when AI can make decisions so quickly?
So I appreciate, then, also, we have heard today really the competition between the good and the bad in AI, because, I mean, the bad guys use AI also, for fraud and other things.
